title: Bessent ramps up pressure on Congress to pass CLARITY Act
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the CLARITY Act is vital to set clear rules for crypto, tokenized assets and decentralized exchanges, and that US leadership is at stake.

title: Morgan Stanley Bitcoin ETF trails BlackRock with $30M in first-day inflows
summary: Morgan Stanley’s Bitcoin ETF drew $30.6 million in first-day inflows, ranking second behind BlackRock’s IBIT as US spot Bitcoin ETFs clocked net outflows on Wednesday.

title: Dubai clarifies token issuance rules for RWAs and stablecoins
summary: Dubai’s regulator issued new guidance placing token launches into three buckets, tightening disclosure and governance standards for stablecoins, RWAs and other digital assets.

title: Bithumb launches legal action to recover 7 Bitcoin from payout error
summary: South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb files for a court-approved asset freeze to reclaim 7 BTC remaining from a February payout error.

title: Yuga Labs settles lawsuit against artists accused of copying its NFTs
summary: Yuga Labs first filed a lawsuit in June 2022, accusing Ripps and Cahen of copying its Bored Ape Yacht Club cartoon ape images and selling lookalike NFTs.

title: Canary Capital submits application for US-based spot PEPE ETF
summary: Canary Capital is preparing to launch an ETF tracking Pepe’s price, despite the token trading 85% below its December 2024 all-time high.

title: Anthropic loses early appeal over Pentagon ‘supply chain risk’ label
summary: “In our view, the equitable balance here cuts in favor of the government,” said a panel of judges from the District of Columbia Court of Appeals.

title: 99.99% of Polymarket traders shouldn't quit their day jobs, data suggests
summary: While nearly 16% of Polymarket users are in profit, only a tiny fraction have made gains large and consistent enough to entertain walking away from their day job.

title: Chainalysis claims stablecoin volumes could reach $1.5 quadrillion by 2035
summary: Two macro catalysts — wealth transfer and payment disruption — could push stablecoin usage far beyond baseline growth forecasts, analysts say.

title: Fed minutes crack door to further rate cuts amid Iran war
summary: Some officials cautiously eyed a year-end rate cut, but others warned that upward adjustments might be needed if inflation remains above target levels.
